THE STEAMSHIP THE DARK SEA
The gangplank is down. If you wait here and try to talk to the 
sailors, go to 494. If you go to see the Captain, go to 487. If you 
want to see the expedition leader, go to 497. Y ou can attempt 
an INT roll once daily: if you are successful, go to 453. Or go to 
any Bremen Location.
